thesis: Zero purchases and thin signups license no refinement; fund the unpriced axis values (count, demo, interest_niche, clicks) before judging any axis
Auto-budget cells were unreadable in both funded batches; retire auto mode and reallocate its budget to readable fixed cells
The only settled purchase came from a sales cell while signup-layer objectives have none; lean budget share toward sales without demoting pv/leads
Fifteen $8-20 ad-cells leave the purchase layer unreadable after four eras; concentrate into fewer, larger cells
Signups are steady but the purchase layer stays dark at 1 buy per $1000; freeze the concentrated shape until a readable purchase base accumulates
Angles are audience-complementary: outcome converts in broad sales cells and named story in interest_biztools; keep the matched pair and judge each angle only in its matched cell
Both matched cells collapsed in the era their winning prompts were reworded; freeze winning creative text verbatim and route wording changes through the challenger gate
Broad-outcome is the per-dollar purchase engine across both purchase-bearing eras; lean the sales split toward it while keeping the biztools matched cell funded
